Ready to Challenge, Create & Change the Courier landscape? 

Pathao is currently seeking highly driven and passionate individuals for the position of Intern, Couriertech. Be a part of one of the strongest teams that solve logistical challenges, makes the functional system flawless and ensures absolute customer satisfaction.

The incumbent will have the responsibility to:

  • Participate in projects and initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency
  • Monitor and report on delivery performance metrics
  • Provide assistance in resolving challenges related to daily operational tasks
  • Execute administrative tasks and ensure accurate record-keeping as required
  • Collaborate with team members on various operational activities
  • Participate in training sessions to enhance skills and knowledge in logistics and operations

Requirements to meet:

  • Graduation/Masters degree program in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field (All courses except for internship must be completed)
  • Excellent computer skills, including sound knowledge in G-Suite (Doc/Sheet/Slides)
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Interested to join? Please apply through the 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗺 and kindly Apply – 

Apply Here

 

We will be accepting applications till September 20, 2026.

content.rendered:
𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐞, 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞 & 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐫 𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐞?
 
𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡 is looking for a 𝐒𝐞𝐧𝐢𝐨𝐫 𝐄𝐱𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞, 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 & 𝐁𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 specialist to join our team. You will own analytics dashboards, build low-code automation workflows, develop AI-assisted tooling, and support model deployment pipelines. This is a hands-on role for someone who gets things done fast using the right tool, whether that is a SQL query, an n8n workflow, a Retool app, or an AI agent built with Claude Code.
 
𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬:
• Build and maintain Metabase dashboards for courier ops, hub performance, SLA tracking, and merchant reporting
• Write complex SQL against BigQuery for ad hoc analysis, KPI tracking, and operational decisions, and define metric definitions and reporting standards
• Automate reports with Google Sheets and Apps Script, including scheduled pulls, summaries, and triggered alerts
• Build internal tools and admin panels in Retool and Appsmith, connected to databases, REST APIs, and BigQuery
• Design multi-step workflows in n8n and Make, linking BigQuery, Metabase, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, Telegram, and third-party APIs
• Identify repetitive manual processes across the organisation and replace them with low-code or no-code solutions
• Monitor and debug live workflows, handling webhook failures and retry logic, and document workflow logic so automations stay maintainable
• Build and deploy AI agents using Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, and Copilot, including multi-step agents built with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or MCP
• Integrate LLM APIs into dashboards and workflows, implement RAG with vector stores, and build persistent agent memory layers
• Deploy internal tools and agent services with Docker and CI/CD, manage nginx and VM environments, and apply security practices around API keys, OAuth2, and signed webhooks
• Serve ML models as REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask, track experiments with MLflow, and monitor deployed models for drift and accuracy
 
𝐑𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬:
• 2 to 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business automation, or a related engineering role
• Hands-on experience with at least two of: analytics dashboards, low-code automation tools, AI-assisted development, or ML Ops
• Portfolio, GitHub repositories, or live work samples showing end-to-end project ownership are strongly preferred
• Logistics, e-commerce, or supply chain analytics experience will get preference
 
𝐇𝐞𝐫𝐞’𝐬 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐘𝐨𝐮’𝐥𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐣𝐨𝐲 𝐚𝐭 𝐏𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐨!
• A dynamic & collaborative workspace
• Competitive salary package
• Two annual festival bonuses
• Leave encashment
• Comprehensive insurance coverage
• Gratuity
• Meal Allowance
• Phone Allowance
• Periodic team dinner
• Exclusive employee discounts on Pathao services
 
If you are interested to know more about the mentioned position, please do check out the detailed 𝐉𝐨𝐛 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 and kindly 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐲 –
 
Apply Here
 
We will be accepting applications till 𝐒𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝟏𝟑, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔.
